name: ASMR Detail
description: Tactile clarity for tapping, scratching, brushes, scissors, pencil, and paper without excessive high-frequency brightness.

filters.comment: Reduce mid-bass boxiness to reveal micro-details
Tactile transient attack for tapping and scissor snips
Delicate friction texture for pencil, fabric, and brushes

notes: Experimental starting profile based on general audio heuristics (subsonic clean-up, boxiness reduction, high-shelf rolloff) and subjective listening. Not derived from physical acoustic measurements of the PRO X SE.
